description.value: Angels Ice Cream is an artisan gelato and gift shop on White Rock's famous Marine Drive, steps from the beach promenade and pier — a natural stop for cyclists riding the waterfront. The shop offers handcrafted gelato alongside coffee, gifts, jewellery, and seashells, blending a sweet treat with a souvenir experience. Its location on one of BC's most scenic coastal cycling routes makes it a memorable mid-ride destination.
